title: Кібератаки групи UAC-0010 (Armageddon): шкідливі програми GammaLoad, GammaSteel (CERT-UA#5134)

entities.name: UAC-0010
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage threat group also known as Armageddon or Gamaredon.

entities.name: GammaLoad.PS1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell-based reconnaissance and downloader script utilized by the Gamaredon group.

entities.name: GammaSteel.PS1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell-based information stealing malware family used to harvest user files.

entities.name: GammaSteel.NET
entities.gloss: A .NET-based stealer malware designed to exfiltrate browser authentication credentials.

entities.name: HarvesterX
entities.gloss: An information stealer malware previously used by the Gamaredon threat actor.

entities.name: Normal.dotm
entities.gloss: The default macro-enabled Microsoft Word template file.

entities.name: PowerShell
entities.gloss: A task automation and configuration management framework from Microsoft comprising a command-line shell.

entities.name: wscript.exe
entities.gloss: A built-in Windows executable used to run VBScript and JScript scripts.

entities.name: mshta.exe
entities.gloss: A Windows utility that executes Microsoft HTML Application files.

entities.name: Telegram
entities.gloss: A cloud-based, cross-platform instant messaging service.

relations.head: UAC-0010
relations.evidence: ланцюг доставки GammaLoad.PS1 на комп'ютер жертви

relations.evidence: Telegram-акаунти, що використовуються для публікації IP-адреси
